entries.name: Retro board (tutorial)
entries.summary: The board the build guide assembles: notes in a register OR-map, votes in a tally OR-map, and presence on the focused note.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: OrMap Presence

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Two people adding notes at once both keep theirs, and two votes on one note add up instead of overwriting.

facts.label: DEMONSTRATES
facts.value: The minimal presence idiom

entries.name: Collaborative dice
entries.summary: The smallest end-to-end Gleam browser client, sharing one last-write-wins die value.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: SharedMap

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Two tabs converge through the same pure core used by the BEAM client and survive reconnect.

facts.label: DEMONSTRATES
facts.value: Sample diagnostics on every event

entries.name: Clap counter
entries.summary: A one-channel stress test for concurrent increments using a state-based PN counter, peer to peer over WebRTC with no server sequencing it.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: PnCounter
links: Treat the server as an optional decorator

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Held buttons in several tabs add every clap without a lost update, and no server ever sees one.
links: Treat the server as an optional decorator

entries.summary: Seven atomic registers retain every submitted match result while settling one official winner per match.

entries.name: Work queue
entries.summary: A job-dispatch board whose columns are consensus queues and locks rather than collaborative card lists.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: OrderedCollection TaskManager SharedSequence

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: One worker wins each claim, and queued work plus dispatcher ownership recover when a client dies.

facts.label: DEMONSTRATES
facts.value: Test client death deterministically

entries.name: Release checklist
entries.summary: A go/no-go room pairing an uncoordinated OR-set checklist with a first-writer-wins captain seat and a quorum-gated release target.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: OrSet Claims PactMap

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Checks converge immediately, exactly one captain seat survives concurrent claims, and only the captain can publish once every gate signs off.

entries.name: Retro board (full)
entries.summary: What the tutorial board grows into: a five-channel sticky-note wall with add-wins notes, conflict-free vote tallies, ordered columns, and presence.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: OrMap SharedSequence Presence
links: When a move is not atomic, crown one channel authoritative

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Concurrent notes and votes survive; cross-channel moves render honestly without pretending to be atomic.

entries.name: Collaborative Sudoku
entries.summary: A typed document combining four durable structures with cursors and typing indicators in the presence tier.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: SharedMap OrSet Claims SharedCounter Presence

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Cell edits, pencil marks, givens, mistakes, and live awareness each use the conflict model they need.

facts.label: DEMONSTRATES

entries.summary: Four independently runnable applications mounted as typed child maps inside one document and one presence roster.

entries.summary: A grapheme-aware textarea bridge with anchors, IME handling, shared cursors, and a composable MVU component.

facts.label: STRUCTURES
facts.value: SharedText Presence

facts.label: PAYOFF RACE
facts.value: Minimal text operations converge without replacing the whole document or losing the local caret.

facts.label: DEMONSTRATES
facts.value: Anchors, not offsets
